verdict.rationale: Linear documents attaching customer requests to the issues and projects they were asked for, and filtering issues and projects by customer data. That is a two-level grouping of requests, not a documented feature/component/initiative hierarchy. Missing for 10: any evidence of initiatives, components or feature-level grouping, documented nesting or hierarchy between these levels, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can organize requests into a hierarchy of features, components, and initiatives

citations.quote: Understand customer use-cases directly on the issues and projects they’ve asked for
View and filter issues or projects by customer name, count, status, tier revenue, and size to identify high impact customer work
